definitions.ask: Which Task Link lines should make the Copy card target the linked task?
definitions.why: Adds a TASK group only where the card shows none today, so no existing row changes meaning

choices.label: Task Link bullets no task owns, in any note; lines inside a task keep their owner
Only Pomodoro Task Links in daily notes; Task Links elsewhere still get no TASK group
Every Task Link bullet, so one under another task targets the link, not that task
